title: Open Frontier Labs compute ledger
description: Public record of who contributed compute to a run. One file covers one run over one period. Nodes are credited by GitHub handle; donated clusters are named as islands.

example.description: True only in files that are illustrative and contain no real data. Must be present exactly when the filename contains EXAMPLE.

run.description: Run identifier, for example run0 or run1.

period.description: Inclusive UTC date range the figures cover.

islands.description: Donated or pooled clusters, named as islands: synchronous inside, DiLoCo-style across.

nodes.description: One entry per node that took part in the run during the period.

name.description: Public display name of the island.

donor.description: Who donated the cluster: a person, organisation or grant, as they wish to be named.

node_id.description: Identifier unique within the file. One handle may run several nodes.

island.description: Id of the island this node belongs to, if any. Must match an entry in islands.

gpu_hours.description: GPU-hours the node was training in the period.

tokens_processed.description: Training tokens the node processed in the period.

helpful_update_share.description: Fraction of the node's submitted updates that lowered the loss, between 0 and 1.
